snippet.text: structure MemClass (s : StripData D) (w : ℕ → D → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (f : ℕ → D → E) : Prop where … bounds : ∀ m, ∃ C ≥ 0, ∃ p, ∀ n x ∈ s.domain, ∀ j ≤ m, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (f n) x‖ ≤ majorant s w α C p n x, with majorant = C * s.epsilon n ^ α * s.growth n x ^ p * w n x and growth = slow n * max 1 (delta x)⁻¹
